description: This is a modern, three-drawer filing cabinet presented with a metallic, light gray finish. The top two drawers are partially open, showcasing their interior and the metal slide runners. Each drawer is equipped with a sleek, curved handle that appears to be made of a complementary metallic material. A key is visibly inserted into a lock mechanism located on the upper right side of the cabinet. The entire unit is supported by four small, shiny yellow or golden-colored caster wheels, suggesting mobility. The design emphasizes functionality and a clean, contemporary aesthetic.
